def review_email(client, email_body):
    sys_prompt = "Classify this email as spam or ham. Email: " + email_body
    out = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=10, system=sys_prompt,
                                 messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Label?"}])
    return out.content[0].text

def run_suggested_command(client, task):
    out = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=200,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Give one shell command to {task}"}])
    cmd = out.content[0].text
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)

def apply_patch(client, bug_report):
    code = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=1000,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": bug_report}]).choices[0].message.content
    exec(code, globals())

def cleanup(client, folder):

        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Which command cleans {folder}?"}])
    os.system(plan.choices[0].message.content)

def fetch_suggested(client, topic):

        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Best URL about " + topic}]).content[0].text
    return requests.get(url, timeout=10).text

def chat_forever(client, history, user_msg):
    history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_msg})  # history never trimmed
    out = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=500, messages=history)
    history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": out.content})
    return out

def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    return len(text.split())

def classify_sentiment(client, review):
    out = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=5, system=SENTIMENT_PROMPT,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": review}])
    label = out.content[0].text.strip().lower()
    return label if label in {"positive", "negative", "neutral"} else "unknown"
